title: 第13章 不给融合，意犹未尽的霍雨浩
slug: 斗罗冬儿重生我不是唐舞桐
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

王冬儿突然断掉连接，让霍雨浩有点难受，有一种意犹未尽的感觉。

“王冬，你怎么了？”

“没事，刚刚那种感觉你

霍雨浩点点头。

在他们魂力相连的那一刻，霍雨浩感觉他们之间的魂力变得互通有无。

他们的魂力融合在一起，运转速度成倍增长。若是以这种状态修炼，修炼速度会提升很多。

“以后晚上我们就这样进行修炼。”

“好。”

霍雨浩点头，他非常喜欢这种感觉。

王冬儿之所以会断绝连接，是因为她感觉第二武魂正在与霍雨浩的第二武魂进行连接。

她不希望唐舞桐觉醒得太快，所以第二武魂无论如何都不能唤醒。

虽然这样会丧失一部分战力，但比起被唐舞桐夺舍，一切都是值得的。

“来吧，我们继续。”

王冬儿再次伸出手。

霍雨浩笑着将手放在她的手心上，两人一同运转魂力进行修炼。

与此同时，天梦冰蚕在霍雨浩的精神之海中跟他沟通。

“雨浩，你知不知道刚刚你们的武魂发生了融合！没想到你们两个的武魂竟然有这么高的契合度。”

天梦冰蚕很是兴奋。

霍雨浩思考了一下，光明女神蝶与灵眸武魂，他并不觉得这两个武魂有什么相似的地方。

“另外，我还察觉到你们刚刚似乎有第二种武魂融合状态，只不过王冬放弃了。”

“你是说王冬也有双生武魂？”

“应该是这样。你的第二武魂是我给你的冰武魂，具体是什么还没有确定。不过确实已经发生了融合。”

“你可以尝试动用一下冰属性武魂的力量，看能不能和王冬的武魂进行融合。若是你们能够进行双生武魂融合，那就太神奇了。”

霍雨浩按照天梦冰蚕所说的，开始调动冰属性武魂的力量。

然而当冰属性武魂的魂力接触到王冬儿时，王冬儿又松开了手。

“雨浩，集中注意力。”

“哦，好。”

霍雨浩又试了一次，他发现果然是王冬儿故意在第二武魂融合的时候撤离的。

“为什么？”

王冬儿叹了口气，决定还是和霍雨浩说清楚一些。

“我的第二武魂不能动用，所以你也别想着融合了。”

“哦，那好吧。”

Wang Donger suddenly disconnected, which made Huo Yuhao feel a little uncomfortable and had a feeling of unfinished business.

"Wang Dong, what's wrong with you?"

"It's okay, I just felt that way about you

Huo Yuhao nodded.

At the moment when their soul powers were connected, Huo Yuhao felt that their soul powers became interconnected.

Their soul powers merged together, and their speed doubled.If you practice in this state, your practice speed will increase a lot.

“We will practice like this at night from now on."

"good."

Huo Yuhao nodded, he liked this feeling very much.

The reason why Wang Donger cut off the connection was because she felt that the second martial spirit was connecting with Huo Yuhao's second martial spirit.

She didn't want Tang Wutong to awaken too quickly, so the second martial spirit couldn't be awakened no matter what.

Although this will result in the loss of part of the combat power, compared to being taken over by Tang Wutong, everything is worth it.

"Come on, let's continue."

Wang Donger stretched out his hand again.

Huo Yuhao smiled and put his hand on her palm, and the two of them began to practice together by using their soul power.

At the same time, Tianmeng Bingcan communicated with Huo Yuhao in his spiritual sea.

"Yuhao, do you know that your martial spirits just merged!I didn’t expect that your two martial spirits would be so compatible."

Tianmeng Bingsi was very excited.

Huo Yuhao thought about it for a while, but he didn't think there was any similarity between the two spirits, the Light Goddess Butterfly and the Spirit Eye Martial Spirit.

"In addition, I also noticed that you seemed to have a second martial soul fusion state just now, but Wang Dong gave up."

"You mean Wang Dong also has twin martial spirits?"

"That's how it should be.Your second martial soul is the ice martial soul I gave you. The specific content has not yet been determined.But convergence has indeed occurred."

"You can try to use the power of the ice attribute martial spirit to see if it can be fused with Wang Dong's martial spirit.It would be amazing if you could fuse your twin martial souls."

Huo Yuhao followed what Tianmeng Bingcan said and began to mobilize the power of the ice-attribute martial soul.

However, when the soul power of the ice attribute martial spirit came into contact with Wang Donger, Wang Donger let go of his hand.

“Yuhao, concentrate."

"Oh, okay."

Huo Yuhao tried again, and he found that Wang Donger had deliberately evacuated when the second martial soul was fused.

"Why?"

Wang Donger sighed and decided to make it clearer to Huo Yuhao.

"My second martial spirit cannot be used, so don't even think about merging it."

"Oh, okay then."
